title: Murmuration: Chromatic Chorus
team: Myeongseong Kim, Ahyeon Lee, Joo-Hong Shin, Gaeun Kang, NaYeon Lee, Bora Youn, Donghyeon Son
summary: A multi-user XR installation that transforms hand-folded and personalized paper birds into virtual agents.
Participants encounter these birds together in a shared immersive environment, forming a collective experience.

paragraph: Murmuration: Chromatic Chorus is a participatory XR installation where hand-crafted paper birds become persistent virtual agents.
Carrying each participant’s colors, patterns, and voice, they leave thread-like trails and sing through accidental encounters.
The work weaves individual traces into a chromatic chorus of collective memory within an evolving virtual ecology across time.
